description: This file implements a traversal utility for JavaScript objects, providing methods for getting, setting, mapping, reducing, cloning, and walking through object properties and structures.

classes.name: Traverse
classes.description: A class providing methods to traverse and manipulate JavaScript objects.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a nested property value based on a path array.

methods.name: has
methods.description: Checks if a nested property exists based on a path array.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a value at a nested property specified by a path array.

methods.name: map
methods.description: Applies a callback to each node in the object structure, returning a new structure.

methods.name: forEach
methods.description: Iterates over each node in the object structure, applying a callback.

methods.name: reduce
methods.description: Reduces the object structure to a single value using a callback.

methods.name: paths
methods.description: Returns an array of all paths in the object structure.

methods.name: nodes
methods.description: Returns an array of all nodes in the object structure.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the object structure.
